comment: Host model policy: each intelligence tier resolves to a host-native model id per harness. Roster roles declare tiers only; explicit model choices live here, never in role or skill sources. Sage and Oracle run frontier-judgment, which on Claude Code resolves to the subagent ceiling (see subagents) and on Codex to Sol; Alchemist runs mechanical-cheap by default (Haiku on Claude Code, Luna on Codex) and its alchemist-specialist card runs balanced-executor (Sonnet on Claude Code, Sol 6.1 on Codex); Sentry runs mechanical-cheap. The subagents block is the single source for the Agent/Task launch gate in legion-hook: a launch whose model ranks above ceilingTier is refused unless its prompt carries the approvalMarker line naming that model, and a launch with no model takes defaultTier. Council runs deliberation as six blind seats plus one adjudicator by role (improvement-path Wonder full via Muse CLI, scope-alternatives DeepSeek V4.1 Flash, user-outcome Kimi K2.6, red-team Fable 5.1 via Claude CLI, security-ops GLM 5.3, minimize GLM 5.3 Flash, adjudicator Astra 6 via Codex CLI; the NIM models run through the council nim-seat script); an explicit human reviewer override may select another available model, including Fable or Astra.
